about: Every scope, claim, gate and refusal reason a vits.me relying party can use. Source of truth for omniauth-vitsme (OmniAuth::Vitsme::Catalog) and for agents and developers choosing scopes. Mirrors the vits.me server: config/initializers/doorkeeper.rb (scopes), config/initializers/doorkeeper_openid_connect.rb (claims), config/initializers/authorizations_controller_extension.rb (value domains, gates, refusals).

conventions.delivery: Every claim except sub comes from the UserInfo endpoint, never the ID token. omniauth-vitsme fetches UserInfo on every sign-in.
conventions.absent_means_undisclosed: A disclosure claim may be missing even when its scope was granted: the person chose to share nothing, holds no such detail, or hid it. Missing is never false.
conventions.person_chooses_the_value: For disclosure claims the person picks the value on vits.me's consent screen, from options at different levels of detail (e.g. a given name, initials, or a full name). Ask for the least you need.
conventions.sub_is_private: sub, solid, defunct_solids and fluid are private per-site identifiers. Store them; never render, log, put in a URL, federate or derive a public handle or email from them.

fluid.description: Also sign in people whose verification is still pending (sub = fluid_...). Cannot be combined with a nationality gate.

sub.format: solid_<base32> for a verified person; fluid_<base32> for a pending signup (only with the fluid scope)
sub.description: Pairwise subject: the same person has a different sub at every site. The OmniAuth uid.

solid.description: Equal to sub for a verified person; absent for a pending signup.

defunct_solids.description: Earlier SOLIDs this site was given for the same person (kept one year). If your record holds one of these, move it to the current sub.

fluid.description: Pending-signup identifiers this site may have been given for the same person in the past week. Merge any tentative account keyed by one into this person.

name.description: One name, at the level of detail the person chose. Not split into given and family names. May be in Hebrew script.

name__full.description: A full name, chosen from the person's full-name forms.

nationality.description: A nationality the person holds and chose to share.

nationality__in_eu.description: Whether the shared nationality is an EU member state.

nationality__in_eea.description: Whether the shared nationality is in the European Economic Area.

nationality__in_esm.description: Whether the shared nationality is in the European Single Market.

nationality__gdpr_compliant.description: Whether the shared nationality is an EEA member state or the United Kingdom.

il_government_id_number.description: Israeli government ID number (teudat zehut). Highly sensitive: request only with a legal need.

age.description: The person's age at the level they chose: a threshold, a generation, a range, or exact years.

age__over_13.description: Whether the person is 13 or older.

age__over_18.description: Whether the person is 18 or older.

age__over_21.description: Whether the person is 21 or older.

birthday.format: M-D (month-day, no year) or YYYY-MM-DD, as the person chose
birthday.description: Birthday. The person may share it with or without the year.

openid_nationality.description: Only verified people holding one of the requested nationalities can finish signing in. Several codes are any-of. Emits no claim: a successful sign-in is the answer. vits.me asks the person's consent for the verdict. Refused people return with error=access_denied and vitsme_error=nationality_gate (or nationality_gate_unverified).

nationality_gate.description: The person holds none of the nationalities the gate requires (or has hidden them).

nationality_gate_unverified.description: A pending (unverified) signup tried to pass a nationality gate.

subject_mismatch.description: The site said whom it expected (claims sub value) and a different person is signed in at vits.me.

application_suspended.description: vits.me has suspended this site. Nobody can sign in to it until the suspension is lifted; its owner sees why on the site's page in the developer area.
